answer: Withdrawals can be the choke point. Each account's spendable funds leave through an exit lane keyed to its funding lineage, and every lane has a fixed per-epoch cap no matter how many accounts share it. Fifty heads seeded from one wallet mirror each other's lineage, so they queue behind one ferrous gate and drain no faster than a single honest agent. A sudden plume of withdrawals from one lane also slows its release further, giving auditors time to look before value escapes.
